tagline: Two chickens re-read their own books. One of them wants to be here.

episodes.title: Before Scratchy
episodes.about: Pearl and Scratchy recap the very first comic. El Jaguar calls in to complain.

lines.text: This is The Supa Recap. The show where two chickens re-read their own books. One of them wants to be here.
HI! I'm Pearl!
I am Scratchy. I was told this would take four minutes.
Today we are recapping the very first comic! Cranky Chickens: Before Scratchy, Pearl, Kevin and Ernesto!
A book about a time before us. We are not in it. And yet, here we are, talking.
Fast fact number one! This book was written by a real kid. On Thanksgiving!
That explains the pacing. Seven chapters. Zero bathroom breaks.
Chapter one! Normal Chickens! Long ago, chickens were normal. They said bawk. They had zero opinions.
Grievance number one. A chicken looks at a rock and says, good rock. That is an opinion. The book says zero opinions. I counted one.
Chapter two! The farmer wakes everybody up at four in the morning. And he counts their corn wrong!
One. Two. Five. Nine. I have never been so upset by a number.
And that is when the first chicken got cranky! The first cranky eyebrow EVER!
A historic eyebrow. It should be in a museum. There is no museum. I checked.
Chapter three is The Egg Scape! They escape the farm dressed as EGGS!
Fast fact. An egg with feet fooled a grown farmer. I would like that noted. Forever.
Chapter four! The farmers hunt for them with pitchforks. But the book says the pitchforks are for pointing!
Good. I had notes.
Then they build a slingshot! Out of a stick and a stretchy farmer sock!
Grievance number two. Nobody washed the sock.
And then the big battle! Splat! Splat! Splat! Nobody got hurt. Everybody got stinky.
Those eggs come back in a later book. A farmer never washes his hair. The hair gets hands. I do not want to talk about it.
We have a caller! Hello, you are on The Supa Recap!
It is I. El Jaguar. I am calling because I am not in this book.
Correct. It was a peaceful book.
I have read all seven chapters. There is no jaguar. I would like a new chapter. Chapter eight. A jaguar arrives. He is tall.
Thank you for calling!
I was not finished.
Final scores! I give this book ten out of ten eggs!
I give it forty-six out of forty-seven. One point off for the rock.
That is our show! And soon there will be a bonus feed for grown-ups, with extra episodes!
It is not ready yet. When it is ready, it will be at the shop. Ask a grown-up. Do not ask me.
Next time: The Childhood of Scratchy and Pearl! We are in that one!
I was a baby. I was already right about everything.
The Supa Recap. Named by a real kid. Goodbye.

episodes.title: The Childhood
episodes.about: The book has them in it this time. Scratchy defends his list. Kevin and El Jaguar call in.

lines.text: This is The Supa Recap. Episode two. Scratchy has asked us to say he did not agree to an episode two.
HI! I'm Pearl! And today's book has US in it!
I am Scratchy. Today's book is about my childhood. I would like it on the record that nobody asked me first.
It is called The Childhood of Scratchy, Pearl, Kevin and Ernesto! Chapter one is Hatching!
Fast fact. I complained from inside the egg. It was cramped in there. I stand by it.
Then Scratchy hatched, looked at the whole world, and said: Hmph. Needs work.
It did need work. It still does.
And I hatched ONE second later, and I have not stopped moving since! That part is TRUE!
Grievance number one. She has not stopped talking since, either. The book left that out.
Chapter two! The School Bully! That is where we meet Kevin the puppy, and Ernesto the jaguar!
Ernesto said, your corn is my corn. So I started a list. The list is called Grievances. This show is basically the list.
Fourth grade! Scratchy learned to count! And I ran for class president, and I WON! Twice!
Forty-seven crayons. One was missing. It is still missing. I think about it.
Fifth grade was the science fair! Kevin brought a stick. Kevin WON.
Grievance number two. I made a chart of everything wrong with the science fair. Nobody gave the chart a ribbon.
We have a caller! Hello, you are on The Supa Recap!
Bark.
It's Kevin! Kevin, how did it feel to win the science fair?
Bark. Bark.
He says it was a very good stick. He is not wrong.
High school! I joined track, band, chess, drama, and a club about clubs!
And Ernesto got a cool jacket. And a doorbell. For his locker.
Another caller! Hello?
It is I. El Jaguar. The book says school bully. I prefer school leader.
You took my lunch corn.
I was leading it. Away from you. Also, the doorbell was very useful. Thank you. Goodbye.
Then college! Cluck University! And then graduation, where I yelled across the whole field that we saved Ernesto a seat!
He said it was a dumb seat. He sat in it anyway. I counted the chairs twice. Forty-seven.
Final scores! Ten out of ten eggs! I was in it!
Forty-five out of forty-seven. One point off for the missing crayon. One point off because I was hugged at graduation. The book did not show it. It happened.
That is our show! The bonus feed for grown-ups is still coming soon!
It is still not ready. I checked. Twice.
Next time: The Attack of the Monster Diapers!
No. Not that one.
The Supa Recap. Scratchy has been told there is an episode three. Goodbye.
